title: FedProto: Federated Prototype Learning across Heterogeneous Clients
layout_note: Server panel spans the top centre; two local-client panels sit side by side below with an ellipsis between them; the uploaded and downloaded quantities travel along orthogonal dashed and solid lines between them.
grouping: Server and each client are large rounded panels with a pale tint and thin grey outline, titled in serif text below or beside (Central Server, Local Client 1, Local Client m). The server panel holds a green inner box with the aggregation equation and a server icon. Inside each client, a left-to-right chain of yellow rounded variable boxes (x, h, y-hat, y) sits under a second row (C_i and the received global C-bar_i).
shapes_depth: Flat rounded boxes in pale yellow for variables, each labelled only with a math symbol; thick dark-grey arrows between them with the mapping written above and its role in italics below (embedding, decision). Losses are salmon double-headed arrows labelled L_R and L_S. Icons: database cylinder with handwritten digit samples beneath, a label tag with coloured class discs (the classes this client holds), a server rack. Upload is a brown dashed orthogonal line, download a dark-green solid one.
proposed_highlight: What is communicated is a named variable box (C_i up, C-bar_i down) rather than a model, and the server's aggregation is written out as an equation in its own green box; heterogeneity is shown by each client's different digit samples and class discs.
lesson: Make the exchanged object a labelled box inside each client panel and route uploads (dashed) and downloads (solid, other colour) as orthogonal lines to a server panel that states the aggregation rule as an equation.
notes: Venue and year from the PDF first page (Copyright 2022, AAAI).

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)

taxonomy.task: federated learning across heterogeneous clients by exchanging class prototypes

core.what: Each client's local prototype C_i rises by a brown dashed line into one server 'Prototype Aggregation' box, and the global prototype C-bar returns by solid green lines to every client's C-bar_i: prototypes, not models, are what converge and fan out.

relations.form: brown dashed orthogonal lines from C_1 and C_m join and enter the green aggregation box at top centre; a green server icon then sends solid green lines down to C-bar_1 and C-bar_m
two identical pale client panels side by side below the server with an ellipsis between, each holding the same x -> h -> y-hat chain
inside each client a left-to-right row x_i -> h_i -> y-hat_i labelled 'embedding' and 'decision', with h_i feeding up to C_i ('Eq. (3)')
salmon double-headed arrows pair C_i with C-bar_i (L_R) and y-hat_i with y_i (L_S) as horizontal neighbours on the rows they compare
each client's data shown as handwritten digit samples under a database icon, its class set as numbered tan discs by a 'label' tag, the sets differing between clients

channels.colour: yellow = variable/representation boxes, salmon = loss pairings, brown = upload, dark green = download and server; green panel = server, pale beige panels = clients
channels.shape: rounded yellow box = representation, cylinder = data store, server-rack icon = server, tag + discs = label set
channels.line: brown dashed = client-to-server upload, solid green = server-to-client download, solid grey = local forward computation, salmon double-headed = loss
channels.frame: a rounded panel = one party (server or one client)

quality.strengths: The communicated objects are drawn as nouns (C_i, C-bar_i boxes) between the embedding that makes them and the L_R loss that compares them; upload and download differ by both colour and dash, and the client panels are identical so heterogeneity shows only in the data and label sets.
quality.weaknesses: Upload and download lines share the gap between the client panels and cross; the aggregation is a typeset equation inside a block rather than drawn; the 'Central Server' title floats outside its panel; the C-bar output of the aggregation box detours via an arrow to a server icon before descending.

insights.structure: A pale-green server panel spans the top centre and two pale client panels ('Local Client 1', 'Local Client m') sit side by side below with an ellipsis between them, each titled in serif text outside its panel.
insights.data: Inside each client a left-to-right chain of yellow rounded variable boxes x -> h -> y-hat -> y (arrows labelled f(phi; .) embedding and g(v; .) decision) sits under a second row C_i and C-bar_i; data is a database icon over handwritten digit samples, and class sets are numbered tan discs beside a 'label' tag icon.
insights.emphasis: What is communicated is a named box (C_i up, C-bar_i down) rather than a model, and the server's aggregation is written out as an equation in its own green inner box; losses L_R and L_S are salmon double-headed arrows inside each client.
insights.flow: Uploads go up as brown dashed orthogonal lines from each C_i into the aggregation box, downloads come back as solid green orthogonal lines from the server icon to each C-bar_i; within clients the chain reads left-to-right with h feeding up to C_i via 'Eq. (3)'.
insights.avoid: Upload and download lines run through the same gap between the client panels and cross each other, and the 'Central Server' title floats outside its panel to the right.

arrangement.units: one rounded server panel on top and two identical rounded client panels below (pale fill, thin grey outline), titled outside
arrangement.inputs_as: database icon with real handwritten digit samples above a yellow x_i box
arrangement.shared: server panel with the prototype aggregation equation, linked to every client by dashed up / solid down lines
